resources.string: Logs hardware key presses (e.g. long-pressing volume) for the Walkie-Claudie button test. Keys are passed through unchanged.

BUTTON TEST — newest presses on top. Screenshot this screen when done.
1. Tap [Start listening] (earphone buttons).
2. Earphone button: single / double / long press — here, on the home screen, with the screen off, inside another app.
3. Volume long-press: [Accessibility] › installed apps › Walkie-Claudie › on. Greyed out? [App info] › ⋮ › Allow restricted settings, then retry.
4. Side key: Settings › Advanced features › Side button › Double press › Open app › "Walkie PTT". Double-press with screen on / locked / off — a beep means it worked.
